DriverInventory.cs.GetPackageFullName: Reads package identity with a zero-length buffer on a query-only process handle. NO_PACKAGE admits an ordinary process with hidden CoreWindows; every unknown result refuses.
DriverInventory.cs.OpenProcessToken: SetLastError preserves access denial so an opened process with an unreadable target token refuses as ELEVATED_TARGET.
DriverInventory.cs.GetTokenInformation: SetLastError preserves access denial during both token buffer sizing and the integrity RID read.
DriverInventory.cs.EnumChildWindows: Enumerates descendants for the ordinary root topology fingerprint with a 4096 limit; an independent parent/sibling walk must return the same set. Packaged-frame resolution remains disabled.
DriverInventory.cs.IsChild: Rechecks that the app CoreWindow still belongs to the same frame before publishing its app identity.
DriverInventory.cs.SetWinEventHook: Observes window structural events without input or activation. Epochs advance only for the tracked process and root subtree, including retained members at destruction.
DriverInventory.cs.UnhookWinEvent: Removes only the topology observer installed by this driver when its owned pump exits.
DriverInventory.cs.GetMessageW: Pumps the driver-owned topology observer queue without creating a window.
DriverInventory.cs.PeekMessageW: Establishes the owned message queue and pumps queued native callbacks at a bounded topology fence.
DriverInventory.cs.PostThreadMessageW: Posts a fixed fence or WM_QUIT only to the driver-owned topology observer thread.
DriverInventory.cs.GetParent: Reads the root parent chain and descendant topology. Never changes a parent or owner.
DriverInventory.cs.GetWindow: Reads owner, first child and next sibling for exact popup ownership and an independently bounded topology traversal; never changes window order.
DriverInventory.cs.GetClassLongPtrW: Reads GCW_ATOM (-32) as read-only lifetime evidence on 64-bit Windows. No class metadata is changed.
DriverInventory.cs.GetClassLongW: Reads GCW_ATOM (-32) as read-only lifetime evidence on 32-bit Windows. No class metadata is changed.
DriverInventory.cs.OpenThread: Opens the observed owning thread with THREAD_QUERY_LIMITED_INFORMATION (0x800) only, to read creation time. The handle is always closed.
DriverInventory.cs.GetThreadTimes: Reads the owning thread creation FILETIME so a reused thread id cannot inherit window admission.

DriverActions.cs.GetForegroundWindow: Read-only HWND samples before and after an action observe foreground changes without activating any window.

DriverInput.cs.GetWindowLongW: Reads GWL_STYLE to refuse ES_READONLY on native Edit and RichEdit; SetLastError=true preserves failure status.
DriverInput.cs.SetLastError: Clears the native thread error before GetWindowLongW so a valid zero style can be distinguished from failure.
DriverInput.cs.LogicalToPhysicalPointForPerMonitorDPI: Converts the actual posted client or wheel packet back to physical pixels at dispatch, then rejects points outside the current admitted root client rectangle.

DriverClipboard.cs.Sequence: WCB1 permits only a content-free GetClipboardSequenceNumber sample before input and after settle/read. No clipboard contents, formats or restoration.
DriverClipboard.cs.SetLastError: Clears the thread error before the sequence read so a valid 0 (no copy since logon) is told from a denied read (0 with error 5)
